description: The marked-pair data supplied by the pinch does not select the Klein quartic -- it excludes it. S_4 has no orbit of size <= 2 on P^2, so no smooth plane quartic carries an S_4-stable point pair. Bean qou-8p1b (parent qou-8pl1).

computation.arithmetic: exact integer matrices + Fraction linear algebra; no floating point

conclusion.argument: an S_4-stable pair {p,q} gives S_4 -> S_2; the kernel has index 1 or 2, so it is S_4 or the unique index-2 subgroup A_4; either way the line through p is an invariant 1-dimensional subspace, contradicting absolute irreducibility
conclusion.consequence: no smooth plane quartic -- no pencil member, and not the Klein quartic -- carries an S_4-stable pair of points

premises_under_which_klein_is_excluded.H1: one S_4-invariant non-separating cycle: exactly one node, giving an S_4-stable pair of preimages (the chapter's own g_arith=4 -> g_geom=3)
premises_under_which_klein_is_excluded.H2: S_4 acts faithfully on the normalization (the chapter's own 'S_4 survives')
premises_under_which_klein_is_excluded.H3: the normalization is non-hyperelliptic, so Aut acts through PGL_3 -- true of the Klein quartic

data.scope: scope-(b) STRUCTURAL EXCLUSION, licensed by a proved invariant (absolute irreducibility of the 3-dim rep of S_4 and of its restriction to A_4, each verified two independent ways: commutant dimension and character norm). Not a scope-(a) numerical negative.
not_excluded: hyperelliptic genus-3 targets (canonical map 2:1 onto a conic; e.g. y^2 = x^8 + 14x^4 + 1 with |Aut| = 48 containing S_4). Klein is not hyperelliptic, so this does not rescue it.
pinches with several nodes, or of a separating cycle (violates H1)
non-faithful actions on the normalization (violates H2, but then 'S_4 survives' is false as stated)
anything about the Bring surface itself -- this constrains the target, not the source
